---
name: micro-app-instructions
description: Apply when creating or changing a route-owned micro app under app, including layouts, pages, domain components, data, and local state.
applyTo: "app/*/**"
---

Read `docs/micro-apps/README.md` and the affected micro-app document before editing. Keep domain state inside its owning micro app and reuse shared layout, navigation, theme, buttons, and icons. Register new home-dashboard apps in `app/page.tsx`. Update the affected micro-app documentation, decisions, and testing notes in the same change.
